notice: Repository-internal generator input. Not a consumer installer, package, or updater.
instruction_authority: org/platform policy > current-task human > project/path instructions > adopted suite > user-global > third-party skills (except vendor API how-to) > model taste
implementation_convention: approved task design > nearest file > package > repository > suite default
bootstrap: **Bootstrap (every task):** this file → protocol → only relevant guides → STATUS if present → test/lint baseline → plan if non-trivial → edit.
hard_items: destructive data, new auth, new deployable, true product ambiguity
always_ask_suite_extra: and before rewriting author-native guide voice without review

routes.need: Protocol (start, ask vs decide, done, handoff)
Section index for any guide (read ranges, not whole files)
Git flow / parallel agents / subagent briefs

suite_only_routes.need: Change the guides themselves (regenerate, budgets, splitting)

skills.description: Code shape, naming, decomposition, helpers, error placement, comments. Nearly every code edit.
System layout: modules vs deployables, folders, new service or package, data ownership, caching.
Language, framework, storage, or major dependency choice. Greenfield picks are never autonomous.
Schema, migrations, keys, nullability, invariants, money, time, Postgres/Mongo/Redis.
HTTP endpoints, events, DTOs, versioning, pagination, idempotency, wire error shapes.
Logs, metrics, traces, request IDs, DB and pool health, data-health checks.
What to test, TDD, repro tests, pyramid, mocks, flakes, legacy pins. Every bugfix gets a test.
Auth, permissions, PII, secrets, IDOR and tenancy, injection, SSRF, supply chain.
Feature flags, expand/contract migrations, rollback, deploy safety, hotfix. Human ships prod.
Branching, PR flow, parallel agents, subagent briefs, conflicts, hotspot serialization.
ADRs: when one is required, format, lifecycle, where they live.
